observations: Photo 0: A cordless drill held in hand, with a battery pack labeled '21V MAX LITHIUM' attached. The drill has a black and silver body with red accents. The chuck key is visible with size markings: 13, 15, 17, 19, 22.
Photo 1: The same drill from a different angle, showing the chuck key with size markings: 13, 15, 17, 25. The drill body has a red trigger and a black handle. The battery pack is still attached.

Photo 2: The drill and battery pack are inside a black plastic carrying case with multiple tool slots. The drill is positioned in the center, with the battery pack resting on the bottom. The case has a handle and a latch. The drill appears to be in a used condition with some dust and minor wear.

claims.claim: The machine is still very new and in good condition
claims.evidence: Photos show some dust and minor wear on the drill and case, but no clear signs of damage. The battery appears intact and labeled, but no proof of functionality is shown.

claims.claim: the battery has to be replaced
claims.evidence: No photo shows the battery being replaced or removed. The battery is attached and appears functional, but its condition cannot be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Fully working, recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete. Original from the manufacturer.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Battery may be dead or not holding charge
risks.proof: A video showing the drill running on battery power, or a photo of the battery being removed and tested with a multimeter.

risks.risk: Drill may not be fully functional (e.g., motor, trigger, or chuck may be faulty)
risks.proof: A video showing the drill being turned on, rotating, and engaging a drill bit.

risks.risk: Battery may be damaged or have low capacity
risks.proof: A photo or video of the battery being charged and discharged, or a multimeter reading of its voltage.

proof_requests: Video of the drill running on battery power.
Photo or video of the battery being removed and tested with a multimeter.
Video showing the drill being turned on, rotating, and engaging a drill bit.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
